diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS; non-GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm. Hans non-GCB should not be treated as definitive molecular ABC subtype.
stage: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage III bulky disease with B symptoms, based on nodal disease above and below the diaphragm and splenic involvement with negative marrow.
biology: Double-expressor lymphoma because MYC is 50% and BCL2 is 80% by IHC. Not double-hit lymphoma because MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements are negative by FISH.
prognosis: Use IPI and CNS-IPI. Supplied IPI factors include age over 60, elevated LDH, advanced stage and ECOG 1; with no confirmed non-lymphatic extranodal site, IPI is 3. CNS-IPI requires additional anatomic risk details.
cns_risk: CNS prophylaxis is not automatically indicated from supplied data. Calculate CNS-IPI and assess kidney/adrenal, testicular, breast, total extranodal sites and other high-risk anatomic involvement.
response_assessment: Use FDG PET-CT with Lugano/Deauville criteria, especially end-of-treatment PET. Biopsy residual PET-positive disease when feasible if it would change management.
